lines.text: تأرجح ذراع البندول (اليمين). ادعم نفسك على طاولة باليد الأخرى ودع ذراعك اليمنى تتدلى وتتحرك بلطف في دوائر صغيرة. دقيقة واحدة، 3 مرات في اليوم. صغير ومسترخٍ. الذراع تتدلى فقط.
lines.source_en: Pendulum arm swing (right). Support yourself on a table with the other hand and let your right arm hang and swing gently in small circles. 1 minute, 3 times a day. Small and relaxed. The arm just hangs.
lines.back_translation: Pendulum arm swing (right). Support yourself on a table with the other hand and let your right arm hang and move gently in small circles. One minute, 3 times a day. Small and relaxed. The arm only hangs.

lines.text: دوران للخارج مع شريط (اليمين). حافظ على المرفق بجانب جسمك وحوّل الساعد للخارج ضد الشريط. 3 × 10، كل يوم. حافظ على مرفقك مضمومًا بجانب جسمك.
lines.source_en: Outward rotation with a band (right). Keep the elbow against your side and turn the forearm outwards against the band. 3 × 10, every day. Keep your elbow tucked in against your side.
lines.back_translation: Rotation outwards with a band (right). Keep the elbow next to your body and turn the forearm outwards against the band. 3 times by 10, every day. Keep your elbow tucked in next to your body.

lines.text: جري مع شريط (الجانبين). اسحب الشريط نحوك بكلتا اليدين، واضغط لوحي الكتف معًا. 2 × 15، كل يوم.
lines.source_en: Rowing with a band (both sides). Pull the band towards you with both hands, squeezing the shoulder blades together. 2 × 15, every day.
lines.back_translation: Rowing with a band (both sides). Pull the band towards you with both hands, and press the shoulder blades together. 2 times by 15, every day.

lines.text: تمدد عضلات الفخذ الخلفية (الجانب غير مذكور). اجلس ورجلك (الجانب غير مذكور) مستقيمة أمامك وانحنِ للأمام من الوركين حتى تشعر بتمدد خلف الفخذ. الجرعة غير مذكورة، التكرار غير مذكور. اجلس، استقامة الرجل أمامك، انحنِ للأمام من الوركين، واحفظها لبعض الوقت. من سجلاتك: انحنِ من الوركين واحتفظ بظهر مستقيم.
lines.source_en: Seated hamstring stretch (side not stated). Sit with your (side not stated) leg straight in front of you and lean forward from the hips until you feel a stretch behind the thigh. Dose not stated, how often not stated. Sit, straighten the leg in front of you, lean forward from the hips, and hold it for a while. From your records: Bend from the hips and keep the back straight.
lines.back_translation: Stretch the hamstring muscles (side not mentioned). Sit with your (side not mentioned) leg straight in front of you and bend forward from the hips until you feel a stretch behind the thigh. Dosage not mentioned, repetition not mentioned. Sit, straighten the leg in front of you, bend forward from the hips, and hold it for a while. From your records: Bend from the hips and keep the back straight.

lines.text: جلوس. استلقِ على ظهرك وركباك منثنيتان واثني جسمك العلوي للأعلى. 2 × 15، كل يوم.
lines.source_en: Sit-up. Lie on your back with knees bent and curl your upper body up. 2 × 15, every day.
lines.back_translation: Sitting. Lie on your back with your knees bent and bend your upper body up. 2 times by 15, every day.
